ivl.en: {n, plural, =0 {again today} one {# day} other {# days}}

deckDone.en: {n, plural, =0 {No cards yet} one {All done for today · # card} other {All done for today · # cards}}

dueNow.en: {n, plural, one {# card is ready for you. A few minutes keeps it fresh.} other {# cards are ready for you. A few minutes keeps them fresh.}}

imported.en: {added, plural, =0 {No cards added} one {# card added} other {# cards added}}{decks, plural, =0 {} one {, # new deck} other {, # new decks}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} one {, # row skipped.} other {, # rows skipped.}}

exported.en: {n, plural, one {# card exported} other {# cards exported}}

moved.en: {n, plural, one {# card moved to this deck} other {# cards moved to this deck}}

unsorted.en: {n, plural, one {Move # card without a deck here} other {Move # cards without a deck here}}

moreProblems.en: {n, plural, one {…and # more row} other {…and # more rows}}

toStudy.en: {n, plural, one {# to study} other {# to study}}

notify.local.purpose: Remind you to study, per deck or once a day for all decks, only when cards are due

files.io.purpose: Import cards from a CSV file and export a deck or all your cards as CSV

widget.home.purpose: Show how many cards are waiting for you on your home screen

dataFlows.purpose: Your cards (front, back, hint and deck) saved as a CSV file where you choose

dailyReminder.label: One daily reminder for all decks
dailyReminder.help: Replaces the reminders you set on each deck.

newPerDay.label: New cards per day
newPerDay.help: How many cards you have never seen come into your study each day. Due reviews always come first.

deck.help: Cards without a deck are kept but not studied

hint.help: Shown only when you ask for it while studying

paused.label: Paused
paused.help: A paused card stays in the deck but is left out of study

ease.label: Ease
ease.help: How fast the gap grows after a Good answer. It drops when a card is hard or forgotten and rises when it is easy.

hardText.compute: =item.ivHard >= 730 ? t('ivlYears', {'n': item.ivHard / 365}) : item.ivHard >= 60 ? t('ivlMonths', {'n': item.ivHard / 30}) : t('ivl', {'n': item.ivHard})

goodText.compute: =item.ivGood >= 730 ? t('ivlYears', {'n': item.ivGood / 365}) : item.ivGood >= 60 ? t('ivlMonths', {'n': item.ivGood / 30}) : t('ivl', {'n': item.ivGood})

easyText.compute: =item.ivEasy >= 730 ? t('ivlYears', {'n': item.ivEasy / 365}) : item.ivEasy >= 60 ? t('ivlMonths', {'n': item.ivEasy / 30}) : t('ivl', {'n': item.ivEasy})

empty.title: No decks yet
empty.body: Make a deck and add cards, or import a CSV or text file with front and back columns. A deck column sorts cards into decks.

empty.title: No cards yet
empty.body: Open a deck to add cards one by one, or import a CSV file there.

deckDoneText.text: =has(record.nextDue) ? 'All done for today. Next review ' + coalesce(formatRelative(record.nextDue), '') + '.' : 'All done for today.'

deckEmpty.title: No cards yet
deckEmpty.body: Add cards below, or import a CSV file whose first row is front,back.

csvNote.text: Import a CSV or text file with the front and the back in two columns, separated by commas, semicolons or tabs. A first line naming the columns (front and back, question and answer, or term and definition) is used when there is one; without it the first column is the front and the second the back. Lines starting with # are skipped. A Deck column sends each card to the deck it names, made for you if it is new.

studyDone.title: All done for now
studyDone.body: =coalesce(params.deck.newCount, 0) > 0 ? 'You have reached today’s new-card limit. Come back tomorrow, or raise New cards per day in the deck.' : 'Nothing else is due in this deck today. Well done.'

leechNote.text: You have forgotten this card many times. Try splitting it into smaller cards, rewording it or adding a hint.

methodNote.text: Spaced repetition: each answer sets when you see a card next. Again brings it back today. Hard, Good and Easy push it further out, and the gap grows each time you remember it.

importAllBtn.label: Import cards from a CSV or text file

irIntro.text: These rows were left out, with the reason for each:

steps.text: Card added. Here is a fresh one for the next.

steps.title: Reset this card's progress?
steps.body: It becomes a new card again. Its past answers stay in your stats.
